interpretation: The monthly Optimizer total is an RQ3 estimate and is not treated as a one-hour provider bill.

A component with a billed count, seat-month, or GiB-month meter contributes its full monthly candidate amount to the conservative short-run reserve because the offline evidence does not prove proration or waive minimum-retention exposure.
All remaining component and route amounts are scaled from 730 monthly hours to the 60-minute run window, multiplied by three, and supplemented by a fixed five-dollar uncertainty buffer.
The proposed cap is rounded upward to the next five-dollar increment and remains pending human approval until the exact Terraform plan and provider billing semantics are reviewed.
The timer reserves the final ten minutes for Destroy initiation and residual-inventory reconciliation; reaching the trigger stops functional work even when verification is incomplete.
